The Philadelphia Eagles acquired the No. 10 pick in the 2021 NFL Draft from the Dallas Cowboys in exchange for the No. 12 pick and a third-round pick (No. 84).

The Eagles used the pick to draft Alabama wide receiver [DeVonta Smith](https://www.nfl.com/prospects/devonta-smith/3200534d-4920-6016-573c-fcc767bafc4d) , the reigning Heisman Trophy winner.

In Smith, the Eagles get a dynamic downfield threat who made a four-year impact at the college level, catching a game-winning TD pass in a national championship game as a freshman, and winning the Heisman Trophy after a prolific season of 1,853 yards and 23 TDs as a senior.
